title: Quasi-coherent realization of a balanced algebra action
statement: Let A and B be commutative rings in Type u, with an A-algebra structure on B. Let f:X -> Spec A be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], M a quasi-coherent O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and rho:B -> End_(O_X)(M) a unital ring homomorphism. Suppose rho(algebraMap(a)) is multiplication by f^sharp(a) for every a in A. Put Y = X times_(Spec A) Spec B [def-pc-fibre-product], with projections pi and fB. Then there exist a quasi-coherent O_Y-module F and an O_X-linear isomorphism e:M ≅ pi_*F such that rho(b) followed by e.hom equals e.hom followed by the pushforward of multiplication by fB^sharp(b), for every b in B. No grading, homogeneous family, coproduct, finiteness, properness or Noetherian hypothesis is assumed.

source.place: Tags 0897 (relative-spectrum paragraph), 01LX (base-change and algebra identification), 01SB (affine module correspondence); source read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0897, /01LX and /01SB on 2026-10-13

proof.text: On each affine U = Spec C, M(U) is a C-module and rho gives a commuting B-action. The scalar equality balances the two A-actions, so (c tensor b)n = c rho(b)n defines a C tensor_A B-module. Quasi-coherence identifies restrictions to D(c) with localization, and naturality of rho identifies their B-actions. Refining affine intersections by basic affine opens glues these actions into an f^*(B tilde)-module whose underlying O_X-module is M.

Use relative-spectrum base change to identify the pulled-back algebra with pi_* O_Y and its relative spectrum with Y. The scalar-restriction clause of affine module correspondence identifies quasi-coherence over pi_* O_Y with quasi-coherence over O_X, so the algebra module from step 1 is quasi-coherent. Apply its equivalence to that algebra module. Its algebra-linear comparison isomorphism, after restriction of scalars, gives e: M ≅ pi_* F with F quasi-coherent. The section b of the pulled-back algebra is fB^sharp(b). Algebra-linearity of e gives rho(b) followed by e.hom equal to e.hom followed by pi_*(multiplication by fB^sharp(b)). Check this formula on the affine cover; sheaf-map extensionality gives it globally.

proof_origin.place: Explication of the ungraded realization in the relative-spectrum paragraph of 0897, with the local action extension and gluing detailed; online sources read on 2026-10-13.

lean.statement:
theorem balancedAction_quasicoherent_realization
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    (M : X.Modules) (hM : M.IsQuasicoherent)
    (rho : B →+* End M)
    (hscalar : ∀ a : A, rho (algebraMap A B a) =
      M.smulHom (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom a)) :
    let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))
    let Y := pullback f g
    let pi : Y ⟶ X := pullback.fst f g
    let fB : Y ⟶ Spec (.of B) := pullback.snd f g
    ∃ (F : Y.Modules), F.IsQuasicoherent ∧
      ∃ (e : M ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward pi).obj F),
        ∀ b : B, rho b ≫ e.hom = e.hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward pi).map
            (F.smulHom (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).inv ≫ fB.appTop).hom b))
